name: Multiplayer
author: Sixth Front
description: Public online play. Press MULTIPLAYER on the main menu: one player hosts a game and gets a 4-letter code, and anyone with the game and the Multiplayer mod joins with it (from the Android app, a browser copy of the game or the claude.ai page) and picks a side. The host's game runs the bots, the flags and the tickets; everyone plays their own soldier, and tanks, jets, bombers and ships are driven by whoever gets in. Works in every battle type (NORMAL, TANKS, AVIATION, NAVAL): the host's battle decides, and a player who has a different one picked can switch to it with one button. Gunfire, grenades, rockets, explosions, kills, revives, spotting and collapsing buildings are shared. Up to 8 players. Players meet through the free public PeerJS server and connect directly (WebRTC); some strict mobile and company networks block that.
